ana: quick summary: RFC proposes a tiny runtime <-> adapter capability negotiation so callers can pick deterministic fallbacks across hosted/dedicated/private. question: how much capability discovery do we expose vs keeping adapters minimal?

matt: i like negotiation but concerned about complexity and attack surface for private installs. gate advanced capabilities behind tenant authz.

siobhan: Dedicated needs predictable SLOs. if capability X is missing, caller should prefer a variant with similar latency profile, not just feature parity.

infra-bot: deploybot: canary-42 finished, no regressions. :white_check_mark:

ana (ana): idea: capability manifest signed by control plane for hosted, signed by customer key for private. client verifies signature before using advanced features.

devon: keep a small stable core API so adapters can always return a minimal success/fallback path. otherwise client code becomes messy.

kevin: propose capability categories: core=[generate,embeddings], advanced=[kv-cache,prefix-cache,stateful-sessions], ops=[metrics-forwarding,trace-headers]. version capabilities and avoid booleans.

siobhan: include performance hints in manifest, e.g. "kv-cache:v2 -> avg-latency-ms:1-3" so callers can pick latency-sensitive fallbacks.

ana: negotiation flow sketch: client->controlplane->adapter: adapter announces signed manifest; client verifies signature and picks fallback policy.

matt: need runtime probes to avoid adapters lying about capabilities. suggest sampled probes on config changes and probe-first for new bindings.

olga: ops: probes must be low-rate, sampled, and produce a decaying health score. avoid probe storms.

devon: runtime-probe: synthetic request exercising capability returns a timestamped signed assertion. controlplane marks capability degraded on failure.

kevin: mid-request failures (e.g., kv-cache OOM) need deterministic semantics: either fail fast or route to compatible variant. prefer deterministic failover + metrics tag.

siobhan: add response header x-redwood-fallback-reason for tracing why fallback happened.

ana: security note: some private tenants won't let manifests leave VPC. support "local-only-manifests" mode where controlplane never fetches manifest; clients validate with customer key. document trust model.

olga: ops ask: add tenant flag auto_fallback: on|warn|off so SREs can opt out of auto-fallback in sensitive tenants.

matt: manifest must be semver-like and include stable subset id so older clients can parse. no ad-hoc booleans.

devon: keep negotiation as a thin protobuf wire contract: capability list + signatures + health vector. no business logic in negotiation.

kevin: add audit events for manifest changes and fallback decisions for compliance.

ana: action: i'll draft RFC appendix with manifest schema, probe protocol, tenant flags, probe-first feature-flag, and a small JS client example. target next wed for review.

infra-bot: ticket ARCH-1842 created: "capability-manifest-probe-and-fallbacks" assigned to @ana. :spiral_note_pad:

olga: also add a feature-flag to force probe-first during private->dedicated migration.

ana: noted, will include. :thumbsup:

matt: overall +1. keep negotiation tiny and auditable.

kevin: i'll sketch telemetry fields and post in #eng-sre tomorrow.

ana: thanks all, will post RFC appendix PR when ready.
